scripts.app:dev: concurrently "npm --prefix renderer run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.app:start: npm run build && ELECTRON_DEV=0 ELECTRON_TRANSPARENT=1 electron .
scripts.app:safe: npm run build && ELECTRON_DEV=0 ELECTRON_TRANSPARENT=0 electron .
scripts.app:test:gpu-on: npm run build && ELECTRON_DEV=0 ELECTRON_TRANSPARENT=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=0 electron .
scripts.app:test:gpu-off: npm run build && ELECTRON_DEV=0 ELECTRON_TRANSPARENT=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1 electron .
